industry: Fund administration, fund governance, ManCos and asset management
client_type: Global fund governance firm (ManCo and fund administrator), €1.3T+ assets under management
task: Replace a fragile legacy SQL Server and SSIS data platform for holdings, risk and regulatory reporting
result: 100TB+ of data processed daily on monitored pipelines, and committee and regulatory packs now come from a single trusted data layer with full audit trails.
text: Waystone, a global fund governance firm with €1.3T+ assets under management, had a legacy SQL Server estate with fragile nightly SSIS jobs. HST moved core holdings and risk data to a monitored AWS data lake and consolidated risk and oversight reporting in Power BI. 100TB+ of data is now processed daily, regulatory packs come from a single trusted data layer with full audit trails, and a separate ETL tool frees up to 40% of analyst time.

client_type: European embedded insurer (insurtech) selling through e-commerce, travel and mobility partners
task: Process continuous partner API traffic in real time without slowing production
result: 100% of API gateway traffic captured in real time with zero latency impact on production, so product and partner teams decide on live data.
text: Companjon sells embedded insurance through e-commerce, travel and mobility partners across Europe, and every partner creates continuous API traffic. HST built a Kafka pipeline mirroring all API gateway traffic, streaming into Databricks, with near real time partner dashboards and access controls. Result: 100% of API traffic captured in real time with zero latency impact on production.

industry: Banking, fund services and digital asset custody
client_type: Regulated bank serving institutional investors and fund structures in the US, Luxembourg and the Cayman Islands
task: Rebuild client onboarding and KYC for three jurisdictions and run its own digital asset custody infrastructure
result: A new onboarding journey is mostly configuration, and the bank keeps full control of its key material with controls it can show a supervisor.
text: iRace Digital (FundBank) serves institutional investors and fund structures across the US, Luxembourg and the Cayman Islands, so onboarding has to satisfy three regulators at once. HST built a shared data model and portal foundation for onboarding (KYC, beneficial ownership, sanctions and PEP screening, FATCA and CRS) and automated self hosted digital asset custody infrastructure on AWS. Result: a new onboarding journey is mostly configuration, and the bank keeps full control of its key material.
